title: Resource repository configuration
description: rigdepot.yaml, at the root of a resource repository: the format version, delivery stages, defaults, product codes and the definitions of personal secrets. Unknown fields are allowed: a field starting with "x-" is yours to use, any other unknown field is reported as a possible typo but does not block anything.

schema.description: The major version of the repository format. This schema describes version 1.

locale.description: The language of every field that has no translation under i18n. Defaults to "en".

requires.description: Minimum versions this repository needs. Declare one when the repository uses a field that older versions do not know; they then refuse to read it and ask for an upgrade instead of guessing.

rgd.description: The lowest version of the command-line program that can read this repository, written ">=1.2.3".

stages.description: The delivery stages, in display order. Left out, the repository has the eight default stages. A stage that resources refer to is never removed, only hidden.

name.description: Display name, in the repository's language.

hidden.description: Keeps the stage out of the user interface while resources that name it stay valid.

defaults.description: Values used for a resource that does not set them itself.

products.description: The product codes this repository uses as scopes. With a server, the server's list of products is authoritative and this one is only cross-checked.

code.description: The code of the product, as used in "scope". "org" and "me" are scopes of their own and cannot be product codes.

secrets.description: The personal secrets resources may refer to, by name. Only definitions live here: what the secret is and where to get one. The value of a secret is never written into a repository.

label.description: What the secret is, for people.

howto.description: Where and how a person gets one.
